answer: Retroactive cluster clawback: every reward vests over a 20-epoch horizon instead of paying out at once. Before release, an auditor clusters identities by funding source, transaction timing and shared infrastructure; accounts that trace back to one wallet, like islands rising from the same ocean floor, lose their unvested pay. An attacker must fund each fake from a separate clean source and wait out the full horizon, and one slip turns the whole farm's earnings into a relic it can never spend.
